review_candidates.title: Network Engineer I
review_candidates.description: SONIFI is known around the world as the best guest technology provider in hospitality, and it’s all because of the people behind the technology. For more than 45 years, SONIFI has been where employees thrive on collaboration and curiosity, helping hotels solve challenges with patented innovations that shape technology experiences for staff, guests, and the best companies in the industry. For the next step in your career, it’s time to set a new standard with SONIFI. Help shape the future of hospitality technology by designing, configuring, and supporting the networks that keep hotels and their guests connected. We’re looking for a Network Engineer with a strong foundation in wired and wireless networking who enjoys tackling technical challenges across all layers of the OSI/TCP models. This role combines network implementation, remote configuration and troubleshooting, customer support, and continued exposure to evolving wired and wireless technologies. What You'll Do As a Network Engineer, you’ll provide full-stack network configuration engineering with focused attention on wireless configurations and optimizations while supporting network solutions throughout the customer lifecycle. Implement network solutions including Wi-Fi, Ethernet, PON, and G.HN, along with IP addressing schemes, RF channel plans, and proposals to provide accurate services. Produce accurate installation documents and design information generated through the site survey and installation processes. Conduct remote configuration and troubleshooting of networks at customer sites during the deployment phase of projects. Configure network components including switches, firewalls, and user experience gateways. Stay current on new technologies supporting the deployment of wired and wireless Internet access. Provide pre-sales, installation, and post-sales network engineering support as needed. Travel occasionally when necessary to perform essential job functions or attend training. What You'll Need We’re looking for a Network Engineer who can troubleshoot across wired and wireless environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and successfully manage project responsibilities with minimal supervision. Proficiency with WLAN, LAN, WAN, TCP/IP addressing and subnetting, along with network diagnostics and troubleshooting. Strong oral, written, and electronic communication skills, along with organizational, multitasking, and decision-making skills. Ability to complete milestones and meet project deadlines with minimal supervision. Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to nontechnical employees and translate nontechnical business and user requirements into technical specifications. Preferred A two or four-year technical degree and two years of relevant experience, although an equivalent combination of education and experience will also be considered. Experience in customer-facing integration roles and installation support. Experience with Wi-Fi 802.11 technologies. Experience with UNIX, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Visio, and Wi-Fi tools such as Ekahau. CWNA, ECSE, RCWA, RCNI, ACA-Campus Access, ACSA, or the ability to obtain relevant certifications. Together, we can build your future! SONIFI offers a competitive compensation package based on factors including location, experience, education, specialty, and training. Compensation for this position generally ranges from $60,000 to $100,000 annually. This position is also eligible for PTO, holidays, health, dental, vision, retirement plans, pet insurance, on-demand pay, and other benefits. SONIFI and SONIFI Health value diversity and are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered regardless of age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any protected status. If you require assistance with the online application due to a disability, please contact Human Resources at 605-988-1000. SONIFI participates in E-Verify to confirm authorization to work in the United States. #Technical
